notes: Fix: the accelerometer bias is no longer learned during motion. Up to 3.12.1 it could absorb real acceleration during slow, steady parts of a rep, so the live velocity drifted, stillness was confirmed late and on a recorded deadlift set 1 rep of 10 was lost; with 3.12.4 the same set gives 10 of 10 and the pauses read 0 in about 0.1 s. Rep values can change by a few percent. The raw vertical velocity in the USB serial log now reads 0 while the sensor is still (per-rep values and the corrected curve unchanged by this part). The bias and drift-correction settings are now firmware-only: values written over Bluetooth for them are ignored. Use companion app 1.0.6 or later. Updating from the app requires the OTAFIX bootloader: https://github.com/ODKI-tech/ODKI-VBT/blob/main/Hardware/Instructions/BOOTLOADER.md Known limitation: the sensor samples at about 95 Hz instead of 100 Hz (velocities are not biased; sample-counted windows are about 5 percent longer); a fix is planned.
